experiment_data.hypothesis: 移除 temporal DIF-flagged items (ETS C, ~31% of MMLU items) 后，模型跨代排名更稳定（Spearman ρ 提升），且稳定性提升显著优于随机移除相同数量 items 的 baseline。这证明 DIF 不只标记 noise，而是精确识别了 problematic items，为 DIF 作为 benchmark quality tool 提供 downstream evidence。

spec.data_path: artifacts/response_matrix.npz + item_metadata.csv + model_metadata.csv + plan_001 DIF results

experiment_data.notes: Hypothesis REJECTED but finding is richer. DIF removal causes MORE ranking disruption than random (z=-8 to -49σ, 21/21 conditions). DIF items are NOT noise — they carry concentrated differential information that systematically discriminates models. Key insight: DIF items capture temporal instability (1.09× cross-cohort accuracy swing vs 0.96× stable items). Rankings are very robust (ρ>0.996 even at 38% removal). Top beneficiaries of DIF items: phi-3 and llama-3 derivatives (+700-850 ranks). Top hurt: mistral merges/slerp models (-400 to -587 ranks). Paper narrative shift: DIF items are not "bad items to remove" but "items that reveal differential model capabilities across generations" — supports characterization narrative over cleaning narrative.
